# Load packages

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

dir.create("Controlled root growth results", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Import data


```{r}
df <- read.csv("controlled_root_growth_data.csv")
```

# Anova

```{r}
model2 <- aov(New.growth ~
            Species * Treatment,
          data = df)

anova_results2 <- anova(model2)
anova_results2
```

```{r}
write.csv(
    anova_results2,
    "Controlled root growth results/ANOVA_table.csv")
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(model2)
```

# Estimated marginal means

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model2, pairwise ~ Treatment | Species)

pairs_df <- as.data.frame(emm$contrasts)
pairs_df

write.csv(pairs_df,
          "Controlled root growth results/Species_Pairwise_Comparisons.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
